english.title: Enter a Midland Metro vehicle stop without an intention of entering a vehicle
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) entered a stop at **(..SPECIFY THE LOCATION..), other than a stop on a street, on the Midland Metro Light Rapid Transit System without the intention of entering a vehicle or every intention of meeting another person at that stop
english.legislation: Contrary to byelaws 4(2) and 2(2) of the Midland Metro System Byelaws 1999 and section 49 of the Midland Metro Act 1989.

english.notes: A person who contravenes this byelaw shall be liable to pay a penalty fare payable to the operator - see byelaw 4(6) together with section 5(1) of the Midland Metro (Penalty Fares) Act 1991
